select ID as id,`NAME` as name,DEPT as dept,DEPT_ID as deptId,ID_NUMBER as idNumber,1 as personType from PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and `STATUS` = '0'
and `NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')
union all select ID as id,`NAME` as name,DEPT as dept,DEPT_ID as deptId,ID_NUMBER as idNumber,2 as personType from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and HR_STATUS='0' and `STATUS` in ('0','1')
and `NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')

select a.* from (select * , CASE WHEN TYPE='注册证书' AND CERT_TYPE='一级注册建造师' AND VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) then '一年' WHEN TYPE='注册证书' AND CERT_TYPE='一级注册建造师' AND VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '半年' WHEN TYPE='注册证书' AND CERT_TYPE='一级注册建造师' AND VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '一个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from HR_CERT_MANAGE where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' ) a ${ew.customSqlSegment}
